faults.name: Leaning back at contact
faults.threshold_source: heuristic: no norm for trunk lean at contact was found in the extracted papers. -10 deg is about 4x the pipeline's trunk-lean error against the labels (MAE 2.7 deg, E2), so measurement error alone rarely fires it. Not calibrated on outcomes.
faults.text_source: heuristic: common coaching advice, not from a cited study

faults.name: Shallow knee bend in the backswing
faults.threshold_source: Xu et al. 2025, p. 4, Table 1 (N-032, verified): peak swing knee flexion 102.71 +/- 6.16 deg with 0 deg = straight, i.e. an interior angle of 77.29 deg. Fires beyond mean + 2 SD (the 2 is heuristic). Caveat: elite players, men and women, measured with IMUs in 3D.
faults.text_source: Kellis & Katis 2007, p. 158: rapid knee flexion then extension stretches and then shortens the knee extensors, and kicking speed is higher with that stretch-shortening cycle (citing Bober et al. 1987).

faults.name: Plant foot far behind the ball
faults.threshold_source: heuristic: the extracted norms give the plant foot's position in cm (e.g. N-027, N-031), and converting needs a leg length in cm that a video doesn't give. A quarter of a leg length behind the ball centre is an uncalibrated guess, and this feature's accuracy has not been measured against labels (E2 doesn't score it).
faults.text_source: heuristic: common coaching advice, not from a cited study

items.what: Your trunk was leaning back at -12 deg when you made contact with the ball.
items.why_it_matters: Leaning back makes the ball go too high instead of staying low.
items.cue: Keep your chest over the ball.
items.drill: Practice slow kicks while focusing on moving your chest forward over the ball as you kick.

items.what: Your knee bend in the backswing was 98 deg.
items.why_it_matters: Not bending your knee enough reduces the power in your kick.
items.drill: Practice the backswing motion slowly while bending your knee further back before you swing forward.

items.what: Your plant foot landed at -0.32 leg lengths behind the ball.
items.why_it_matters: Planting too far behind the ball makes it hard to strike cleanly.
items.drill: Practice stepping up to a stationary ball and placing your plant foot closer before kicking.
